method: Independent production source, retained source SHA256 and raw React/CodeMirror result review; no tests rerun

relocation.name: relocation preserves real CodeMirror undo and does not reuse the old saved baseline

sourceFindings: A failed first open creates an owner-scoped unavailable buffer and tab; prior draft remains separate. Retry replaces that same file identity after a successful open.

Relocation prepare waits for native dirty marking and a current checkpoint, then uses the native-selected plan. Cancel clears proposal state. Apply preserves or replaces the buffer according to the explicit choice.
keepBuffer rekeys the same buffer and CodeMirror cached state, clears the former saved-content identity, and retains real Undo; the retained run confirms Undo stays dirty against the new target.
Clean checkpoint identity is cleared only after native document_mark_dirty acknowledgement, then emits a fresh state.

FileRecovery supplies retry, native locate, close-this-tab, optional save-copy, candidate/current comparison and explicit discard or keep choices; this UI is source-reviewed, not executed by the CodeSurface-only harness.

operatorReportedChecks.command: rtk test node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --dir packages/editor/src store.test.ts

provenanceLimits: store44 and desktop:check exit/counts are operator-reported from original tool output; raw command logs were not saved and unavailable history was not reconstructed.
Headless 17-phase JSON is retained and independently audited. Its CLI exitCode is operator-reported; transport responses are controlled fixtures.
Harness renders production CodeSurface with real React/CodeMirror but does not render FileRecovery/EditorWorkbench or invoke the native picker.
The initial broad vitest substring run selected archived source test copies and failed module resolution; corrected --dir run is reported separately.
Native G02, three-project/cold-restart scroll and 044 Undo acceptance remain pending the central new package.
